migrationRisks.finding: Standalone 29 KB SFC Search Visibility Report and generated editorial case share one URL; legacy Vite route-copy build overwrites the copied report with an SPA shell. Blindly copying public into Astro retains a conflicting output owner.
migrationRisks.action: Choose the Astro editorial case as the explicit route owner; preserve the legacy report source for review/archival reuse, excluding the conflicting direct public index.html from generated output.

migrationRisks.finding: Current route generator substitutes head metadata into one React shell and copies homepage into 404.html.
migrationRisks.action: Replace route-copy generation with Astro static routes that render each full body; generate a real 404 and inspect raw response content.

migrationRisks.finding: 55 Mermaid blocks across 20 notes are currently browser-rendered. Two notes embed style/radio interactions; the AI-money-stack note uses inline styles.
migrationRisks.action: Preserve HTML/tables/SVG/CSS interactions. Prefer build-time SVG for diagrams, or accessible pre-rendered diagram/text fallback plus bounded enhancement. Test HTML-only and JS-on; do not import Mermaid into every page.

migrationRisks.finding: Published writing is three HTML strings and one Markdown string. Four draft records have no body. Current exported slugs are unique; existing listing retains defensive dedup.
migrationRisks.action: Select published status only, parse the Markdown at build time with marked, render reviewed HTML with Astro set:html, sanitize excerpt text/entities, preserve month-only date precision and newest-first ordering.

migrationRisks.finding: Content imports publicPath through import.meta.env.BASE_URL. Arbitrary plain-Node imports fail without bundling/definition. Study-note HTML hardcodes root-relative /images paths. SEO also uses VITE_SITE_INDEXABLE in a client effect.
migrationRisks.action: Use Astro-supported build-time base handling consistently, keep root deployment paths, avoid double prefixing, and put canonical/robots metadata in the server-rendered Astro head. Staging must stay noindex.

migrationRisks.finding: Legacy /* /index.html 200 catchall config would restore SPA behavior on supporting hosts.
migrationRisks.action: Exclude or replace legacy catchall with explicit intended redirects only; preserve correct direct 200/301/404 behavior.

migrationRisks.finding: Wouter route state, DOM SEO, scroll/reset and hash synchronization, clipboard, Radix dialogs, and filter useState need targeted conversion. Package dependencies include a much larger unused UI kit.
migrationRisks.action: Use native anchors/static navigation, real resume links, native details/menu enhancement and scoped lab islands/scripts; keep primary content and forms usable without hydration. Retain only needed dependencies.

migrationRisks.finding: Study-note generator reads an absolute private Desktop youtube-library folder and writes public source/assets.
migrationRisks.action: Migrate from checked-in published studyNotes + public images. Do not invoke generator in Astro build or copy private transcripts/library into public output.

migrationRisks.finding: Data has nine vibeProjects, but page prepends SFC for ten displayed builds; this is not the unverified approximately fifteen active-project inventory. No UBI case/source appears in these files.
migrationRisks.action: Preserve all ten displayed builds and exact status labels, separately reconcile new project identities and real external demo/app links. Do not imply every case is an active project.

migrationRisks.finding: Four approved two-page PDFs have stable 2026 filenames.
migrationRisks.action: Copy PDF bytes unchanged and retain all four hrefs and default resume. Do not regenerate during framework migration; verify hashes/200 and visible native downloads.

migrationRisks.finding: caseStudies and vibeProjects retain placeholder instruction strings despite resolved approved image assets; one image provenance note includes an old replace-later instruction.
migrationRisks.action: Use getStudyImage image/alt/provenance and editorial narrative, not placeholder fields; avoid surfacing internal production instructions.
